LITERATURE IN ENGLISH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: LITERATURE IN ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goed
   B. going
   C. goes
   D. went

2. When practising Poetry 1.2.1 Appreciating Poetry Elements of poetry - Persona - Subject matter -, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   C. Use insults to “practise” Poetry 1.2.1 Appreciating Poetry Elements of poetry - Persona - Subject matter -.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Poetry 1.2.1 Appreciating Poetry Elements of poetry - Persona - Subject matter -.

3. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Many unrelated topics with no link
   B. Only one word repeated
   C. One main idea with supporting sentences
   D. No full stops

8. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only an action
   B. Only a describing word

9. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
